name: Runner Extras - Virtual Field Table
brief: Proves the virtual Field table (2000000041) enumerates a table's real field metadata via the managed find-interception path.
description: Self-contained reproduction of the RecoverySolutions 'Library - Workflow'.EnableWorkflow gap, which does Field.SetRange(TableNo,<t>); Field.FindSet() and threw 'There is no Field within the filter.' because the virtual Field system table (2000000041) returned zero rows (and SIGSEGV'd inside BC's R2R native InnerFindAsync prologue on the skeleton session). Defines its OWN table so the test needs no Base App, then iterates the virtual Field table filtered by that table's ID and asserts the real fields are returned with correct No./Name/Type, that the No.<>1 and Type<>BLOB filters behave exactly as BC's EnableWorkflow uses them, and that a non-existent table yields zero rows (no fabricated rows).
